import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

def run(inputs: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> dict[str, pd.DataFrame]:
    invoices = inputs["invoices"].copy()
    
    # Initialize reason_codes column as empty strings
    invoices["reason_codes"] = ""
    
    # R1: amount IS NULL OR amount < 0 -> 'AMT_BAD'
    r1_fail = invoices["amount"].isna() | (invoices["amount"] < 0)
    invoices.loc[r1_fail, "reason_codes"] = invoices.loc[r1_fail, "reason_codes"] + "AMT_BAD"
    
    # R2: tax IS NULL OR tax < 0 -> 'TAX_BAD'
    r2_fail = invoices["tax"].isna() | (invoices["tax"] < 0)
    # Append with pipe if reason_codes already has content
    mask = r2_fail & (invoices["reason_codes"] != "")
    invoices.loc[mask, "reason_codes"] = invoices.loc[mask, "reason_codes"] + "|TAX_BAD"
    invoices.loc[r2_fail & ~mask, "reason_codes"] = invoices.loc[r2_fail & ~mask, "reason_codes"] + "TAX_BAD"
    
    # R3: tax > amount * 0.5 -> 'TAX_EXCESS' (NULL-safe: skipped if amount or tax is NULL)
    r3_fail = (~invoices["amount"].isna()) & (~invoices["tax"].isna()) & (invoices["tax"] > invoices["amount"] * 0.5)
    mask = r3_fail & (invoices["reason_codes"] != "")
    invoices.loc[mask, "reason_codes"] = invoices.loc[mask, "reason_codes"] + "|TAX_EXCESS"
    invoices.loc[r3_fail & ~mask, "reason_codes"] = invoices.loc[r3_fail & ~mask, "reason_codes"] + "TAX_EXCESS"
    
    # R4: due_date IS NULL -> 'DUE_NULL'
    r4_fail = invoices["due_date"].isna()
    mask = r4_fail & (invoices["reason_codes"] != "")
    invoices.loc[mask, "reason_codes"] = invoices.loc[mask, "reason_codes"] + "|DUE_NULL"
    invoices.loc[r4_fail & ~mask, "reason_codes"] = invoices.loc[r4_fail & ~mask, "reason_codes"] + "DUE_NULL"
    
    # R5: customer_ref IS NULL OR TRIM(customer_ref) = '' -> 'REF_EMPTY'
    r5_fail = invoices["customer_ref"].isna() | (invoices["customer_ref"].str.strip() == "")
    mask = r5_fail & (invoices["reason_codes"] != "")
    invoices.loc[mask, "reason_codes"] = invoices.loc[mask, "reason_codes"] + "|REF_EMPTY"
    invoices.loc[r5_fail & ~mask, "reason_codes"] = invoices.loc[r5_fail & ~mask, "reason_codes"] + "REF_EMPTY"
    
    # Split into clean and rejects
    has_failures = invoices["reason_codes"] != ""
    
    invoices_clean = invoices[~has_failures].drop(columns=["reason_codes"]).reset_index(drop=True)
    invoices_rejects = invoices[has_failures].reset_index(drop=True)
    
    return {
        "invoices_clean": invoices_clean,
        "invoices_rejects": invoices_rejects
    }
